rationale.observed: V1 complete system loses money. Leader-breakout branch has 44 closed episodes, signal NTR20 median 7.276491029481135 percent and initial failure distance median 0.6977686076639527 NTR. Stop exits dominate realized losses. Sector exits are net positive as a conditional actual-episode group.
rationale.inference: The first entry definition may select volatile late strength without a prepared support base. This is a hypothesis, not a causal finding or proof that another exit would improve returns.
rationale.priorNegativeEvidence: A separate historical NTR<=5percent cap experiment failed; a volatility ceiling alone is not proposed as the solution.
rationale.newHypothesis: A dated leadership relationship followed by a support retest, contracting range/turnover and renewed demand can improve the complete system's realized payoff and account outcome.

All V1 sector strength, three-session confirmation, top-three ordering and sector risk exit
Same 4999 raw stock sources, continuous 500000 CNY capital, periods, fees, slippage, calendar and model quality controls

causalSequence: T-5: Establish leader roles using the then-published same industry snapshot
T-10 through T-1: Observe a two-block ten-session preparation path, with no unknown session compressed
T close: Confirm market, sector, role, support retest, contraction and first renewed-demand breakout
T close: Reserve actual cash and fees, stock and industry capacity, quantity and price risk
Next calendar-session open: One attempt, reduce quantity only, reject incoherent price/support distance
Holding: Apply common persistent risk exits and allow ratcheted winners without fixed profit ceiling

stockRoles.leaderBase: Candidate is a V1 industry leader both at T-5 and T, same published snapshot, currently above MA20; positive60 return and other V1 candidate health remain required
stockRoles.catchup: Preserve V1 catchup current-return ranks and distinct healthy leader identified exactly T-5 in same snapshot; additionally apply the same preparation and support rules as leaders
stockRoles.disabledBranchControl: Remove catchup new entries only; common account rules and leaderBase entries remain
stockRoles.leaderReclaim: No separate one-candle reclaim entry; all leader entries must complete the dated base sequence

baseDefinition.completeDataRequired: All ten raw OHLC/amount observations valid; recent five MA20/MA60 and all feature endpoints valid; otherwise no candidate
baseDefinition.trendPreserved: Every recent-five close above its same-day MA60
baseDefinition.supportRetest: At least one recent-five low <= its same-day MA20
baseDefinition.rangeContraction: max(high[T-5:T-1])-min(low[T-5:T-1]) strictly less than the corresponding earlier-five range
baseDefinition.turnoverContraction: Recent-five mean amount <= prior20 mean amount ending T-1
baseDefinition.renewedDemand: T close > preceding-five highs; T-1 close <= its own preceding-five highs; T amount > prior20 mean amount ending T-1
baseDefinition.healthAndOverextension: Retain V1 positive60 return, close>MA60, close<=MA20+2*NTR20*close and valid positive prior20 amount
baseDefinition.failurePrice: Actual minimum low across T-5 through T-1; do not replace a distant observed support with an artificial 95percent-of-close floor
baseDefinition.signalRiskCoherence: One inclusive-T mean NTR20 <= (T close - failurePrice)/T close <= 0.05; positive NTR required
baseDefinition.openingRiskCoherence: Using modeled actual opening buy price including slippage, one signal NTR20 <= (modeledPrice - fixedFailurePrice)/modeledPrice <= 0.05; reject otherwise
baseDefinition.existingOpeningCeiling: Retain raw open>fixedFailurePrice and raw open<=signalClose*(1+signalNTR20); no retry
baseDefinition.interpretation: Risk coherence plus a complete prepared base is the hypothesis. The implied NTR<=5percent is not standalone evidence or a separate searched threshold. Actual losses may exceed 5percent under close-confirmed next-open execution.

ordering.sector: Unchanged V1 exact composite percentile rank and sector-code tie break
ordering.intent: Choose liquid members among prequalified role-and-base candidates rather than mechanically selecting the largest current60-return rank
